title: Ask
alt: A curious child raises one hand while two children nearby listen.
scene: A curious child seated on a classroom rug raises one hand high, open questioning expression. Two other children sit around listening calmly. No adult.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Square single concept composition. A curious child seated on a classroom rug raises one hand high, open questioning expression. Two other children sit around listening calmly. No adult. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
